However, Charlotte has several highly respected dental practices and specialists known for their expertise in dental implants. 

When looking for the best implant dentist, it is generally recommended to see a **Periodontist** (gum and bone specialist) or an **Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeon** for the surgical placement, and a **Prosthodontist** or experienced cosmetic dentist for the crown (the visible tooth part). Many top implant dentists in Charlotte handle both the surgery and the restoration in-house.

*   **Charlotte Periodontics & Implant Dentistry:** Led by specialists in periodontics, this practice focuses heavily on the foundation of dental implants—the gums and jawbone—ensuring high success rates for placement.
